method: Per attempted order revenue contribution from user-provided gross price, refund fraction, payment processing fraction and fixed fee, extra refund cost and non-payment variable costs. Cash break even versus creator labor compensation target.
assumptions: Refused and refunded orders return the gross product price in full.
Payment processing charges are assumed incurred even if an order is refunded; policies vary by seller and channel.
A nonpayment variable cost is incurred per attempted order, including any nonrefundable fulfillment/delivery charges.
Refund_extra_cost represents additional expenses per refunded attempt and is separate from gross refunded price.
Creator labor is valued at a chosen target compensation amount, not a measured market hourly wage.
No defaults or unknown fee rates; all numeric inputs must be explicitly supplied by the user.
YouTube ad views, Shorts engaged views and membership subscribers are not attempts at a merchant checkout.
